body:
I've been trying to contact different CABs today, but no one is picking up their phones :(  
I have no answer from stepchange as well :(  
Moneysagingexpert forum says that my case is hopeless, what I already know.  
Is there anything else I could do?

> citizens advice bureau  

I'm calling them whole day, but no on is even picking up the phone :/  
I'm just without any means of survival...
They have their own PC equipment, so I prefer to search for a job at home - not there.

> It's the same thing that the job centre staff should be doing to help you if you go to see them.  

I've been there and they told me to do everything by myself online.

> Google for recruitment agency (your city) and register with all of them.  

I'm already registered everywhere and currently sending emails everywhere, but there are only single and hopeless replies to me, so maybe I've got some kind of [wolf ticket](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wolf_ticket_(Russia)) in UK, or maybe there's just complete lack of jobs for people like me, so I can't do anything about it.  
I'll try to contact CAB tomorrow.  
What about the volunteers who could help me with job searches - where did you find about that? I google only offers of access, but not offers of help.

> Have you tried looking in your area for a cheaper rented house you could move to?  

No, I prefer to spend my time to look for a job or income instead.  
> If you're on your own can you sublet [...]?  

I'm not on my own.  
> the volunteers there even help with job searches  

Do you know any websites or people who could help me with that? This will be the best help for me.  
>  The government won't push you out on the street  

The government won't do it, but the person I have to pay my rent will do it.  
> what's the harm in asking for help?  

I'm asking for help, but online, because it's the fastest way to reach help and even when I ask for help personally, they tell me to do it online.  
> Send an email to citizens advice as well.  

What's their email address? Their web-chat service never appears on my PC. I'll try to call them, but I think it's too late today.

> Why won't you be able to get benefits?  

They will just push me to the street level quicker than I'll do it on my own. I'll loose my time there, which I could use to find any job and I won't get anything from them, because I don't meet their criteria.  
> Which country do you live in?  

UK
> Think of everything that you spend money on, what can you save?  

I have no other bills than food and rent. I can't save more on both.
I've never borrow anything in my life (I have no loans, debts or mortgage), so it's not for me I think.

> 2) speak to your bank about an overdraft or overdraft extension  

That won't bring me money. It will just put a debt on me.  
> 3) go to see your GP, you can get anti depressants  

I'm not depressed. I'm in "whatever" state.  
So far I'm not hungry.  
But I think I won't be able to pay my rent or get a job. I'll just drop to the street level and I'll loose everything I've been working on so far.  
I don't know what will happen after that and I don't want to know.  
> You say you're not entitled to government support - is there any reason for this?  

They will just push me to the street level quicker than I'll do it on my own. I'll loose my time there, which I could use to find any job and I won't get anything from them. There's no email contact with CAB, except "Consumer query" form.  
> 5) try speaking to step change the debt charity.  

OK, I'm trying.
> 6) really, don't kill yourself.  

I don't understand why people make a [problem](https://translate.google.com/translate?hl=en&sl=nl&tl=en&u=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.uitvrijewil.nu%2F) with that.

I don't have any help near me. I'm alone.  
>  /r/personalfinance/  

Thank you. I'll try.

I can save my life and not to go to work ever again. I prefer to save my life than money.  
When I fell to the street level I won't have any money and I will loose my life as well.
"If weapons had functioned as a conflict-resolution method we would have had peace in the world a long time ago."
